review_history.initial_freeze: The exact-reuse hypothesis, non-overfit boundary, dependency split, cache layer, synthetic equivalence requirement, and promotion gates were written before production implementation.
review_history.pre_public_hardening: Adversarial review before any Phase 7 public run added an explicit immutable-backend capability, payload-free token type, hashed session keys, bounded ASCII IDs, measured cache bytes, an untrusted-backend fail-closed test, and a conservative label-free warm-up/run order.

purpose: Add a deterministic pre-query value decision that avoids retrieval and reranking only when their result is provably unchanged, while preserving every Phase 6 user-visible decision.

allowed_development_inputs: catalog schema and immutable runtime asset metadata
synthetic product IDs and deterministic fake route pools
forbidden_policy_inputs: hidden intent card or simulator state
non_overfit_boundary.public_evaluation_rule: Run one frozen baseline/candidate comparison only after implementation, synthetic tests, source hashes, and gates are locked; do not tune Phase 7 from its misses.

frozen_components.retrieval_routes: BM25 Top-100 plus BGE-small dense Top-100

candidate_change.scope: pre-query orchestration and bounded in-memory caching only
candidate_change.equivalence_scope: Exact Phase 6 user-visible equivalence is required for the built-in deterministic immutable HybridRetriever capability. Untrusted, mutable, top-k-dependent, or capability-unknown retrievers fail closed to SEARCH and are never cached. A prior backend failure is never cached; a later transient failure from a capability-compliant immutable backend is outside the capability contract and may be masked by an already proven ranking.

actions.search: Run the frozen retrieval and Stage-A ranking path whenever ranking evidence changed, no trustworthy snapshot exists, or the prior attempt was incomplete or degraded.
actions.reuse: Reuse a complete successful pre-slate ranked pool only after exact dependency equality.
actions.skip: For a non-positive requested result count, skip retrieval because an empty recommendation list is required.

candidate_change.ask_and_recommend_invariant: Clarification and recommendation are independent. On ordinary turns the agent still recommends and asks one unresolved question when allowed; it never substitutes ask-only for a useful recommendation.
candidate_change.confidence_semantics: Intent completeness is exposed only as bounded evidence telemetry, not as a calibrated probability and not as a threshold for suppressing changed searches.
candidate_change.recomputation_value: Exactly zero only for a valid dependency-identical cache hit or an empty requested result; otherwise one.

included: ordered active requirement value, source, and attribute
ranking_dependency_contract.separate_identity_check: opaque retrieval-backend snapshot token compared by identity
ranking_dependency_contract.backend_capability: The backend must expose the exact immutable-complete-fused-ranking-v1 singleton and a bounded payload-free snapshot token. A token or similarly named property alone cannot enable reuse.
excluded_after_dependency_audit: no-preference markers that do not remove an active requirement
ranking_dependency_contract.exclusion_reason: These fields do not affect retrieval or Stage-A ordering. Intent version and requested top-k remain in the existing slate signature, so overrides and window-size changes still reset slate history.

cache_contract.layer: complete successful Stage-A ranked pool before slate selection
cache_contract.session_key_storage: Store only a 32-byte SHA-256 digest of session_id, never the raw session identifier.
store_only_when: both route statuses are ok or empty
the entire ranked pool is normalized, unique, non-empty, and at most 200 IDs
cache_contract.historic_contract_supersession: For the Phase 7 candidate only, this explicitly supersedes the Phase 4 statement that candidate text/ranking is not cached across turns. Candidate text remains transient and is never cached; only ranked IDs are retained. The Phase 6 baseline remains cache-disabled.

synthetic_confirmation.inputs: label-free fixed fake backends, synthetic IDs, slot canaries, and natural message contrasts
isolation_cells: reset one session without disturbing another

execution.order: synthetic invariants, complete unit suite, implementation lock, one unlabeled untimed backend warm-up, one cold-cache Phase 7 candidate, one cache-disabled Phase 6 baseline, one Phase 7 deterministic replay, then independent starter.Agent verification
execution.latency_bias_control: The fixed candidate-before-baseline order is conservative for the candidate after a single label-free backend initialization warm-up; no public query is used for prewarming and no best-order selection is allowed.
execution.parallelism: strictly sequential for all model and evaluator work
